newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones fell 36.52 points to 6,268.35. PLDT's ADR dropped by $0 1/8 to $57 5/8.
* On Monday, the peso closed at 26.296 to a U.S. dollar from 26.298.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,115.58, down 4.62.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was at 10.9375 from 10.8125 pct.
